messages:
Maria: Heads up — planning to announce Dedicated Autoscale + Optimize suggestions on Wed 2026-03-25 10:00 PT. Need engineering signoff on changelog + docs links + rollout timing by EOD tomorrow. @Jake @Derek @Sophia :eyes:
Jake: Got it. Quick Q — are we rolling out feature flag `dedicated-autoscale` immediately or staged canary?
Sophia: Canary first. 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~4h. Marketing: do you want to hold press until 50%?
Maria: Yes please hold press until we hit 50%. We don't want half the fleet missing the feature.
Derek: Docs draft updated (internal): https://redwood-docs.internal/release/dedicated-autoscale. Public-ready version I can push after word from eng. Changelog snippet below:
```markdown
### Dedicated Autoscale
- GA: Autoscaling for Dedicated GPU pools
- Config: `autoscale.min`, `autoscale.max`, `burst_capacity`
- Rollout: staged canary; feature flag `dedicated-autoscale`
```
Ping for corrections.
Jake: Confirming flags: `dedicated-autoscale` + `optimize-recommendations`. Gate conditions: infra smoke tests green + anomaly detectors stable. I will wire an alert to #eng-oncall if error rate > 1%.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: staging 2026-03-24T02:00Z, prod canary 2026-03-25T17:00Z -> prod full 2026-03-25T21:00Z :calendar:
Maria: Marketing needs a public docs link we can point press to (no internal-only paths). Derek — can you confirm public URL?
Derek: Public URL ready: https://redwood.com/docs/releases/dedicated-autoscale-2026-03. Removed internal notes, added "known limitations" section and a short FAQ.
Jake: Note: if anomaly detector trips we auto-fallback to the previous serving variant — should be seamless customer-side. No planned customer-visible downtime.
Sophia: Messaging check for copy team: lead with cost predictability + SLA-backed autoscale. Benchmarks: claim ~20% latency reduction under steady load vs baseline. Marketing will include a tiny graph — engineering, can you sign off on the number?
Jake: Perf runs on p4d: median token latency improved ~18–22% on our standard prompt set. I'll upload the perf artifact to the release folder after CI finishes.
Maria: Can we get final greenlight by 2026-03-24 17:00 PT? I need to lock the press list and the webinar invite email.
Jake: Yes, aiming for that. I'll escalate if any infra blockers show up.
Derek: Docs link is public and final. Changelog snippet is updated.
Maria: :rocket: Thanks everyone — I'll draft the announcement and share a PR for quick reviews. Tag me with any edits. (reaction :thumbsup:)
